events.message: Our next stop: The mill bend. Bring the useful things; leave the rest where we made them. We collect the things needed for this scene along the way.
Our next stop: Bread for the journey. Bring the useful things; leave the rest where we made them. We collect the things needed for this scene along the way.
Place Dough at Warm cellar, then bring Wild starter onto Dough. Only the receiving thing needs to be placed there.

playerReport: Reached journey complete. Initial axe and planks chain and rope footbridge were satisfying intelligible crafts. Wheel recipe needed a hint; wheel versus axle versus planks distinctions lacked explanatory descriptions. Mill parts gave empty hints until gear existed, causing an unnecessary trip back for axle and materials. Axe plus wheel making gear then waterwheel gearing plus millstone was coherent after discovery. Flour sack and final basket were clear but routine. Bakery revived interest through a setting: cellar description suggested fermentation, but direct combinations with cellar failed; starter onto dough gave excellent exact receiving-item placement guidance. Flour plus air starter was a satisfying guess. Total 34 attempts, 25 accepted, 19 creations, 7 hints, 2 visits, 1 placement, 3 advances. Finished because this short journey had reached its ending; would not seek more generic pair filling right now. Logical-interface source-blind play only, not a claim about human fun or graphics.
